## Payment
Priya said a 50% deposit is too much for their cash flow this quarter because the winter season was weak. We agreed to move to 40% upfront and split the rest into two milestones. I will send a revised proposal (v3).

## Booking system
Jonas wants bookings for groups of up to 12 people in one order, and a waitlist when trips sell out. The current system double-books guides when two people check out at the same moment. Gift cards came up again.

## Decisions
Payment structure changes to 40 / 30 / 30. Waitlist and group bookings are in scope; gift cards are out of scope for this phase.
